name: East Trewent Farm
dogs: Welcome by arrangement, one per cottage
beachAccess: A few minutes' walk to Freshwater East beach
boardStorage: Space to store boats, bikes or surfboards
confirmedFeatures: Wi-Fi, central heating, wood burner (Granary), ground-floor bedroom, welcome hamper, board and bike storage
overview: East Trewent Farm has four self-catering cottages on Stackpole Road, a few minutes' walk from Freshwater East beach and the coast path. They sleep two to six and come with a welcome hamper.
surfTripFit: Stated surfboard storage and a short walk to the beach make it one of the most surf-friendly stays here.
